LanguageData.MTC_RightClickHint: Right-click to customize this map tab.
LanguageData.MTC_ShowOnlyOnHoverDesc: Hide map labels and icons until the pointer is over their colonist group.
LanguageData.MTC_ReplacePawnPortraits: Replace pawn portraits with fixed-size map tabs
LanguageData.MTC_ReplacePawnPortraitsDesc: Replace the colonist bar with one compact, fixed-size tab per map, using the selected map icon. Tab size no longer depends on pawn count.
LanguageData.MTC_CompactTabHint: Left-click to open this map. Right-click to customize its tab.
LanguageData.MTC_ShowActiveMapPawns: Show the active map's normal pawn portraits
LanguageData.MTC_ShowActiveMapPawnsDesc: In fixed-size mode, restore the native pawn portraits for the active map. Inactive maps remain compact icon tabs.
LanguageData.MTC_AlwaysShowActiveLabel: Always show the active map's label
LanguageData.MTC_AlwaysShowActiveLabelDesc: Keep the active map's label and icon visible even when labels are configured to appear only on hover.
